data.title: r14-oliver-schmidt.pdf
data.context: The document is a resume for Oliver Schmidt, presenting his background and impact as an MLOps leader. It highlights 10 years of experience taking ML and LLM services from development to production on AWS and GCP, including building feature store and model registry using Kubeflow and MLflow. It also lists his professional roles, core skills, certifications, languages, and education.

data.title: r17-grace-liu.pdf
data.context: The resume presents Grace Liu, a data scientist with 4 years of experience focused on payments fraud and NLP for customer support. It highlights her current role at Mangrove Pay building fraud-detection models and a transformer-based multilingual support ticket routing system, along with relevant education, skills, certification, and language proficiency.

data.title: r01-aarav-mehta.pdf
data.context: The document is a resume for Aarav Mehta, a senior machine learning engineer focused on AWS-based production systems. It highlights 8 years of experience building recommendation/ranking and LLM-powered retrieval (RAG) solutions, including improving hallucination rates and fine-tuning models for customer support. The resume lists skills, certifications, work experience across Lumora Commerce and Brightpath Lending, and education (M.Tech and B.E.).

data.title: r13-zoya-ahmed.pdf
data.context: The document is a resume for Zoya Ahmed, a Senior Business Analyst with 7 years of experience focused on payments and e-commerce analytics. It highlights her work leading pricing and promotions analytics, building a Looker promotion-ROI model, and designing A/B testing guardrails, along with forecasting payment volumes and success rates using Power BI. The resume also includes a one-year career break in 2021–2022 and lists her MBA and BA education, core skills, and languages.

data.title: r22-siddharth-rao.pdf
data.context: The resume describes Siddharth Rao, a Staff Machine Learning Engineer with 13 years of experience, focused on recommender systems and (since 2023) LLM and RAG systems. It highlights his work at Tejas Mobility on rider-driver ML architecture and an LLM support assistant using RAG, as well as part-time consulting advising startups on RAG architecture and evaluation. The document also lists relevant skills, languages, and an M.S. in Computer Science.

data.title: r02-priya-raghunathan.pdf
data.context: The document is a resume for Priya Raghunathan, a lead data science professional with 12 years of experience in healthcare and insurance analytics. It highlights her leadership in building forecasting and causal inference models for hospital patient-flow and readmission-risk use cases, along with earlier experience in bed-occupancy forecasting and claims analytics. The resume also lists her education, core technical skills, and spoken languages.

data.title: r06-meera-iyer.pdf
data.context: The document is a resume for Meera Iyer, a Senior Product Manager with 11 years of professional experience across software engineering and product leadership. It highlights achievements in learner experience roadmapping, A/B testing, and e-commerce payments/checkout optimization, along with relevant skills, education, a certification, and listed languages.

data.title: r12-michael-brennan.pdf
data.context: The document is a resume for Michael Brennan, an engineering executive with 18 years of experience, including nine years leading engineering organizations in healthcare SaaS. It outlines his experience at Tallgrass Health and Cobaltline Software, highlighting AWS/Kubernetes platform consolidation, team growth, and backend development in Go. It also lists his education (M.S. and B.S. in Computer Science), core skills, and English as his language.

data.title: r07-kenji-watanabe.pdf
data.context: The document is a resume/profile for Kenji Watanabe, an AI Research Engineer in Tokyo. It highlights 4 years of experience training and evaluating large language models, with a PhD focused on retrieval-augmented language models and current work on RLHF and long-context evaluation. It also lists education, relevant research experience at Sorahana Labs, and core technical skills and languages.
